name: Animated Blood (Bloody Dagger) summons its amalgam instead of doing nothing (#9370)
contract: Spell 909064 'Animated Blood' (the Bloody Dagger's on-use spell) is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 3333313, which had no creature_template row: the cast succeeded but nothing appeared. Registering the creature (mirroring the #51 fix for its sibling ranks) lets the summon resolve. Cast the spell directly to isolate the summon defect from whether the quest-reward item row exists in the harness world database.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the Animated Blood amalgam is summoned
